text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 6: Predictions on months the models never saw, three days at every farm'
text.tspan: Figure 6: Predictions on months the models never saw, three days at

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Six NGED solar farms, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS: satellite irradiance service. Top: measured output and the predictions of G0 and G9, on three days chosen for each farm (the clearest, most variable, and dullest). Bottom: each farm's mean absolute error for G0, G1, G2, and G9. The days are chosen by the CAMS clear-sky index. Clear-sky index: measured irradiance divided by the irradiance expected under a cloudless sky. A variable set is the list of inputs the XGBoost model is given. G0: sun position, ERA5 solar radiation, and air temperature. G1 adds total cloud cover, G2 adds low, mid, and high cloud cover, and G9 adds every other ERA5 variable studied. Output is a percentage of each farm's own capacity.'
